ui_bugs.issue: Every Save from the brand-settings modal triggers a step-up MFA prompt ('To change your settlement currency, confirm it is really you') even when the settlement currency was NOT changed and only the webhook URL was edited. Root cause: handleSubmit unconditionally awaits axiosBaseApi.put(API_ENDPOINTS.company.autoConvert(...)) with no dirty-check. Gate the auto-convert PUT behind an actual diff against the loaded values.
